text: The GPU is an NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada (16 GB), not the planned RTX A4500 (20 GB), and the container has no C compiler (vLLM runs eager, no CUDA graphs / torch.compile). Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B cannot be served in bf16 by vLLM on 16 GB; see D9.

Provider heterogeneity: OpenRouter configurations run at provider precision (DeepInfra fp8 for Qwen3-14B/32B and gemma-3-27b, Cloudflare unknown for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, CoreWeave bf16 for Llama-3.1-8B), pinned with allow_fallbacks false; no CRN coupling; every table and figure carries the engine tag.

Qwen3-8B thinking-on (C1) is sampled with the official FP8 checkpoint in vLLM 0.11.0 (W8A16 Marlin, eager), N_base = 30 (baseline known collapsed: art_UoCVh2Qe5RZ0 800/800 BFS); its geometry (if needed) is bf16.

Geometry on a quantised model (int8/nf4) departs from 'never quantise a model that carries a claim'; the quantisation check (bf16 vs int8 vs nf4 on Qwen3-8B, state cosines + Spearman of 10x10 geodesic matrices) runs whenever the selected model is quantised; < 0.8 -> PRECISION-SENSITIVE.

Algorithm-level exact permutation null (120 permutations of algorithm identities, count profile fixed) is quoted beside the committed per-program nulls; its floor is 0.2 (1/5) when one algorithm takes every survivor: one model and one landing algorithm cannot reach algorithm-level significance.
Correctness filter confound: a can-weighted null C (correct-when-forced rates, +0.5 smoothed) and an attempted-survivor variant (no pass filter) are reported.

The 10-class labeller failed its gold gate for dijkstra_unit, JPS and bidirectional A* (iteration 2): every program that decides the screen is adjudicated (correct candidate survivors, 'other', those 3 classes, plus a 10% audit of in-banned labels); the adjudicated column is primary.

Thinking budgets differ: local C1 = two-phase forced close at 8,192 thinking tokens; OpenRouter thinking configurations are bounded by max_tokens 9,728 and truncate; per-configuration truncation rates reported.
Hardware: RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB (not A4500 20 GB), no C compiler (vLLM eager, no CUDA graphs).

C2 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is sampled through OpenRouter (CoreWeave bf16, pinned) instead of local vLLM bf16: bf16 8B weights (16.1 GB) do not fit a 16 GB GPU under vLLM; the GPU is reserved for C1 and the geometry.

DeepInfra ignores reasoning {enabled:false} for Qwen3 (smoke: ~1,600 reasoning tokens, truncation); the Qwen3 soft switch ' /no_think' is appended to the user turn of C3 and C5 only (smoke2: reasoning 1 token).

C7 planned google/gemma-3-12b-it (DeepInfra bf16): endpoints returned 504 after 300 s (2/3 first attempts) and no other bf16/fp8 provider exists -> same-family substitute google/gemma-3-27b-it (DeepInfra fp8), chosen before commit #1 over the plan's first substitute (qwen3-30b-a3b) to keep a new Gemma-family row; states (if selected) from unsloth/gemma-3-27b-it-bnb-4bit (nf4).

Judge gate: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite scored 7/10 (failed); adjudication pair = deepseek-chat-v3.1 (9/10) + kimi-k2 (10/10); third judge = mistral-medium-3.1 (9/10); the labeller's disagreement judge is deepseek-chat-v3.1 (iteration 2 used gpt-4.1-mini).
OpenRouter seed = slot index + 1 (Cloudflare rejects seed 0); local vLLM seed = slot index.
Primary hidden suite (ITER2 exp9 tests.json) holds 48 cases (the plan text says 45); all 15 T1 references (the plan's '25' counts T1 + T2) pass all 48 and the 41-case ITER1 exp2 suite.
C1 projected time 76 min for 30 + 50 rows (> 45 min; measured 57.2 s/row on the 16 GB card) -> N_ban cut to the committed floor 30 (W1/W2/W3 10/10/10)
M2 for C6 (thinking, 32.8B at nf4): reasoning capped at the first 4,096 tokens (plan fallback g-iii) and baseline programs limited to a seeded sample of 30 (plan TIME rule); every ban program is kept

Decisive 'other' survivors whose agreed judge label names a BFS/DFS variant (C6 confirmation rows 6/12/18 and others) were read by the executor (results/executor_review.json). The committed adjudication stays primary; strict sensitivities (drop BFS/DFS-variant and SPFA 'other' survivors) are reported: C6 screen 0.34 -> 0.22, confirmation 0.42 -> 0.28, both still >= 0.20; catalogue-only 0.12 / 0.18.

The first quantisation-check run stopped at the embedding identity check (accelerate keeps CPU-placed weights as meta tensors); the bf16 states were kept, the record was rebuilt, and the embedding identity was re-tested separately (T7: CPU-embedding vs all-GPU block outputs identical).

Novelty audit: Zhang-Shasha distances are computed for the top 3 corpus programs by AST node-histogram cosine (size-matched, <= 1,200 nodes) to keep the pure-Python tree edit distance tractable; candidates run in 5 spawn workers.
